checks.name: Changing projects loads that project role and returning restores its own preview
Uploads use the record project role while another project is displayed
Owner takeover of another project does not change the current project role
Nonmember directory pages remove the service context
Editing redaction record A after B never edits B’s pending revision
Missing references link to the environment repair page
Fixing referenced variables clears the obsolete connection error
Credential selector uses current environment names without another project’s fixtures
Saving a call creates its own upload snapshot identity and browser queue
Editing metadata creates a new snapshot while keeping the saved record identity
Saving and editing preserve the source invocation snapshot and link
Translation additions exist in both languages
A nonmember project maintainer cannot reach member management, while an Admin can
Project management actions stop after membership loss even when the previous role was Maintainer
